tcs.test_item:
After completion of the speaker activation sequence, the Audio Management software shall restore the previously stored audio settings

(Confirm the settings return once the speaker activation sequence ends)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source with known volume, tone, fade and balance values
2. Trigger a signal source that activates a loudspeaker
3. Wait until the signal source ends
4. Read the volume, tone, fade and balance values and record them
tcs.expected_result:
1. Entertainment audio plays with the set values
2. The signal source activates a loudspeaker
3. The signal source ends
4. The four settings are the values held before
tcs.reasoning: Shares 4866662 with B4's leaf 176 across batches, declared under the package 22 section 3 procedure and approved at package 26 section 3. 176 observes the recall after a routing change; this row observes it after the speaker activation sequence, the two upstream decompositions of one recall sentence. All four settings are read because a partial restore is what the word settings guards against.

tcs.test_item:
Before activating audio output through the HU/AMP, the Audio Management software shall store the current audio mode settings in persistent storage

(Confirm the settings are stored before audio reaches the loudspeaker)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source with known volume, tone, fade and balance values
2. Trigger a signal source that requires a loudspeaker
3. Read the stored audio mode settings and record them
tcs.expected_result:
1. Entertainment audio plays with the set values
2. The signal source requires a loudspeaker
3. The stored audio mode settings are the values held before it started
tcs.reasoning: 4866674 is the HALF-system store, written for HU and AMP together where the earlier sequences name the HU alone — which is what separates it from 171 and 173 in B6.

tcs.test_item:
After HU/AMP activation completes, the Audio Management software shall retrieve and apply the previously stored audio settings

(Confirm the stored settings return at the end of that same sequence)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source with known volume, tone, fade and balance values
2. Trigger a signal source that requires a loudspeaker
3. Wait until the signal source is deactivated
4. Read the volume, tone, fade and balance values and record them
tcs.expected_result:
1. Entertainment audio plays with the set values
2. The signal source requires a loudspeaker
3. The signal source is deactivated
4. The four settings are the values held before
tcs.reasoning: 4866677 is the recall that closes 177's sequence, confirmed by reading 4866675 to 4866680 as package 26 asked: the ramp-up, the ramp-down on deactivation, then this recall, all carrying the HU/AMP form.

tcs.test_item:
Upon receiving $TBMMuteReq$ = Mute, the Audio Management software shall store the current volume level of all active audio sources in persistent memory before applying the mute policy

(Confirm every active source has its level stored when the mute request arrives)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source and an Information source at known volume steps
2. Send $TBMMuteReq$ = "Mute"
3. Read the stored volume levels and record them
tcs.expected_result:
1. Both sources play at their set steps
2. $TBMMuteReq$ reports "Mute"
3. The stored levels are those of both active sources
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-AM4 signal not found in the supplied DBC; name kept as written in CFTS019 per R-13 (g)
tcs.reasoning: 4866714 says all currently active sources, so the case runs two of them: storing one and dropping the other would pass a single-source check and lose a level on restore.

tcs.test_item:
During system initialization, if AudioSystemType = Base, the Audio Management software shall enable loudspeaker diagnostics and report electrical faults (open circuit, short-to-battery, short-to-ground, short-between-terminals) through the Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) mechanism

(Confirm an electrical fault on a loudspeaker line is detected and reported)
tcs.pre_conditions: The vehicle is configured with a Base audio system
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Introduce an open circuit on a loudspeaker line
2. Read the reported loudspeaker diagnostic and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The loudspeaker line is open
2. The loudspeaker diagnostic reports the fault
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: Partial coverage. 4867162 lists the electrical faults the head unit detects — open circuit, short to battery, short to ground, short between terminals — but says nothing about the initialisation timing the leaf gives for enabling the diagnostics, so the case observes detection and stops there. The open circuit is taken as the representative fault; the clause's list is not enumerated into four rows because the requirement is the detection, not the taxonomy.

tcs.test_item:
When AMPAudioStatus = Not_Available, the Audio Management software shall set HUAudioStatus = Not_Available and maintain this state until AMPAudioStatus = Available

(Confirm the head unit follows the amplifier into the unavailable state and back)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send $AMPAudioStatus$ = "Not_Available"
2. Read $HUAudioStatus$ and record it
3. Send $AMPAudioStatus$ = "Available"
4. Read $HUAudioStatus$ again and record it
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-AM4 signal not found in the supplied DBC; name kept as written in CFTS019 per R-13 (g)
tcs.reasoning: 4867426 holds the head unit in the unavailable state until the amplifier recovers, so the case drives the signal back as well: a latch that never released would satisfy the first half. The anchor is the head-unit-side object; 4867177 states the amplifier side and is out of pool, so it is not the one.

tcs.test_item:
Each time the BH-CAN bus wakes up, the Audio Management software shall restore the previously stored configuration settings from persistent storage

(Confirm the stored configuration comes back on each bus wake-up)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set the configuration settings to known values
2. Put the vehicle through a bus sleep and wake cycle
3. Read the configuration settings and record them
tcs.expected_result:
1. The configuration settings hold the set values
2. The bus wakes
3. The configuration settings are the values stored before
tcs.reasoning: 4867457 is the head-unit clause; 4867458 and 4867459 say the same for the amplifier and the ANC, and this leaf is the head unit's, so those two are not it.

tcs.test_item:
Upon exiting Sleep Mode, the Audio Management software shall reset the stored Navigation volume to <NAV vol min> when the stored level is below that limit

(Confirm a stored Navigation level below the limit is brought back to it)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set the Navigation volume to a step below 15 steps
2. Put the head unit through a sleep and resume cycle
3. Read the Navigation volume step and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Navigation volume holds the set step
2. The head unit resumes
3. The Navigation volume step is 15 steps
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.reasoning: 4866141, one of the seven consecutive sleep-resume clauses at 4866141 to 4866147. Each names a different source and a different limit, which is what separates them — the sentences are otherwise the same shape, and that is why the matcher collided on three of them. <NAV vol min> resolves at 1.5.4 Variables to 15 steps, so the case carries the real figure. Written as a boundary case because the clause is a clamp. Out-of-pool anchor: the whole sleep-resume block is absent from the export, and none of it is a figure — a further instance for DR-AM3 in its corrected form (A-AM13).

tcs.test_item:
Upon exiting Sleep Mode in a LATAM market vehicle, the Audio Management software shall reset the stored Phone volume to <HFP Vol Th min LATAM> when the stored level is below that limit

(Confirm a LATAM vehicle uses its own phone volume floor on resume)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Configure the vehicle market as LATAM
2. Set the Phone volume to a step below 19 steps
3. Put the head unit through a sleep and resume cycle
4. Read the Phone volume step and record it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The vehicle market is LATAM
2. The Phone volume holds the set step
3. The head unit resumes
4. The Phone volume step is 19 steps
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.reasoning: 4866143 is the LATAM variant of 4866142, re-anchored at package 26 after the matcher gave both leaves the same object. The two differ only in the market and the threshold — 19 steps at 4867754 against 15 at 4867753 — so the market is established in step 1 rather than left to the reader. Out-of-pool anchor.

tcs.test_item:
When the system enters Logistic Mode, the Audio Management software shall disable all audio output channels

(Confirm entering logistic mode silences every output channel)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Play an Entertainment source
2. Enter Logistic Mode
3. Record the audio on every output channel
tcs.expected_result:
1. Entertainment audio plays
2. Logistic Mode is active
3. Every output channel is muted
tcs.reasoning: 4867027 mutes all output channels, so the case reads every one: a partial mute in a transport mode would leave audio in a vehicle that must be silent.

tcs.test_item:
When Logistic Mode is entered, the Audio Management software shall set HUAudioStatus = Not_Available. When Logistic Mode exits, the Audio Management software shall restore HUAudioStatus = Available

(Confirm the audio status reports unavailable while logistic mode holds)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Enter Logistic Mode
2. Read $HUAudioStatus$ and record it
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-AM4 signal not found in the supplied DBC; name kept as written in CFTS019 per R-13 (g)
tcs.reasoning: 4867028 is the status half of the entry that 4867027 mutes. The exit is 244's own object, so the three form the mode's full cycle across three leaves.

tcs.test_item:
When the power mode changes from Logistic_Mode_ON to Standard_Power, the Audio Management software shall exit Logistic Mode and restore all previously disabled audio output functionalities

(Confirm leaving logistic mode restores audio output)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Enter Logistic Mode
2. Change the power mode from "Logistic_Mode_ON" to "Standard_Power"
3. Play an Entertainment source
4. Record the audio on the output channels
tcs.expected_result:
1. Logistic Mode is active
2. The power mode reports "Standard_Power"
3. The Entertainment source starts
4. The output channels carry the Entertainment audio
tcs.remarks: PENDING: DR-AM4 signal not found in the supplied DBC; name kept as written in CFTS019 per R-13 (g)
tcs.reasoning: 4867029 keys the exit on the power-mode transition rather than on any audio request, so the case drives the signal and then checks that audio is possible again — which is what closes the cycle 242 and 243 open.
